{{Top|leg}}
'''Sienar Sentinels''', abbreviated '''ISS''', were [[Picket ship/Legends|picket ships]] that served the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|starfleet]] of the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] under [[Head of State (Imperial Remnant)|Head of State]] [[Jagged Fel]]. Imperial Sienar Sentinels enforced his [[Home Fleet (Imperial Remnant)|Home Fleet's]] [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Exodo II]] and the remains of the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Boreleo]], but [[Abeloth]] slipped past the siege and contacted the rival Imperial [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Natasi Daala]] in [[44 ABY]]. The [[Starship/Legends|starship]] shared its name with the manufacturer [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]].
